title: Breaking the Silence: Mental Health in Hong Kong
topic_description:
Recent studies highlight a concerning rise in mental health issues, particularly among young adults in Hong Kong. Contributing factors include academic pressure, social media influence, financial anxieties, and a fast-paced, competitive environment. The stigma surrounding mental health often prevents individuals from seeking help, exacerbating the problem. Early intervention and increased awareness are crucial. 

Consider the following excerpt from a recent survey:

"70% of respondents aged 18-25 reported experiencing symptoms of anxiety or depression in the past year. However, only 25% sought professional help. The primary reasons cited were fear of judgment, lack of awareness about available resources, and financial constraints."

Discuss how to improve mental health awareness and support systems in Hong Kong.
discussion_points: Causes of the increase in mental health issues among young adults in Hong Kong.
Impacts of poor mental health on individuals and the wider community.
Effective solutions to promote mental well-being and reduce stigma surrounding mental health.
individual_response_questions: What is one thing you can personally do to promote mental well-being among your peers?
Do you think the government is doing enough to support mental health initiatives? Why or why not?

candidates.A: Actively supports implementing mental health education in schools and universities.
candidates.B: Skeptical about the effectiveness of large-scale campaigns; emphasizes individual responsibility.
candidates.C: Focuses on practical and affordable solutions, such as online resources and community support groups.
